prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: wide landing-page hero visual for Sabino Software Ltda
Primary request: an original retro-futurist systems topology showing data flowing through a precision-engineered software platform: abstract database cylinders, packet streams, compute nodes, cloud infrastructure, AI-agent nodes, terminal-like panels without readable text, and hardware circuit traces, all connected as one coherent pipeline
Scene/backdrop: deep near-black graphite field with subtle blueprint grid and generous clean negative space on the left for website copy
Style/medium: premium editorial technical illustration; a sophisticated hybrid of vintage computer service manuals, 16-bit hardware schematics, and contemporary data-platform visualization; crisp, architectural, highly polished, not a game screenshot and not a generic cyberpunk scene
Composition/framing: very wide landscape composition, visual system concentrated on the right two-thirds, layered depth but restrained, clear flow from source to processing to output
Lighting/mood: controlled phosphor glow, precise and calm, expert engineering rather than flashy futurism
Color palette: graphite black, warm off-white, restrained phosphor green, electric cyan, and a very small amber accent
Materials/textures: matte panels, subtle scanline grain, etched circuit paths, luminous data pulses
Constraints: no words, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no trademarks, no people, no watermark; preserve large uncluttered negative space on the left; avoid tiny illegible pseudo-text; must remain elegant when cropped responsively or displayed at low opacity behind real HTML content
Avoid: neon overload, purple cyberpunk, stock 3D blobs, hacker hoodies, Matrix code rain, photorealistic server racks, busy dashboards, fake brand marks
